race.title: Stag Environmental Handicap Hurdle
race.verdict: COURAGEOUS STRIKE looks the class angle in here, and he's taken to resume winning ways following a breathing operation. Course specialist Taritino is feared most, ahead of Into Battle and Holeshot . COURAGEOUS STRIKE TARITINO (IRE) INTO BATTLE (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Into Battle (2/1), Venetian Beauty (11/4), Courageous Strike (5/1), Lunar Orbit (6/1), Taritino (6/1), Cornish Storm (14/1), Holeshot (33/1)
